task: Cover the notes page with its Trash view (`/`), seeded with three notes and one note already in the Trash. Delete moves a note from the Notes view to the Trash view and the Trash tab shows the count in parentheses; a note is never shown in both views. Restore moves a trashed note back to Notes. Empty trash asks for confirmation and permanently removes everything in the Trash, which then shows `Trash is empty`. Deletions, restores and emptying are stored on the server and survive a reload.
